description: This PHP source file defines a class ResetDatabaseController within the OrangeHRM's functional testing namespace. The class provides a method to restore the database to its initial state and return a JSON response indicating the number of tables affected.

classes.name: ResetDatabaseController
classes.description: Controller class responsible for resetting the database to its initial state during functional testing.

methods.name: handle
methods.description: Handles the request to reset the database, restoring it to the initial savepoint and returning the number of tables affected as a JSON response.
